entry.content:
Tammy-ann has been my pilates instructor for over 10 years. I have osteoarthritis and scoliosis. Tammy-ann adapts and fine tunes every movement to my needs. I have absolute confidence in her instruction and always enjoy our sessions.

She is acomplished in many different types of pilates and is always keen to try new ideas to make our sessions more interesting.

Kitty, Walgrave
